question: The 1960 Broncos wore secondhand mustard-and-brown uniforms with vertically striped socks. In 1962 a new coach made a public show of getting rid of those socks. What did he do?
question_short: The 1962 Broncos made a public show of ditching their striped socks. How?
answer: A: Burned them in a bonfire
answer_detail: Coach Jack Faulkner torched the much-mocked mustard-and-brown socks at a 1962 team scrimmage in Golden as Denver switched to orange and blue. One sock survived and ended up at the Pro Football Hall of Fame.
answer_short: Jack Faulkner torched them at a 1962 scrimmage; one survivor sits in the Hall of Fame.
